reason: Panel packing is the most direct distinct n=512 layout test, though its extra repacking and pointer changes create correctness risk. Prefetching is a smaller, bounded test; address generation is feasible but close to a previously measured pointer-end variant. Indexed loads and transpose fusion require broader assembly changes. The cache-blocking proposal describes a two-K loop that conflicts with the supplied current one-step K loops and risks repeating tested unroll work. A-transpose and tail-alignment changes do not target the n=512 hot path. No proposal has evidence of a gain; prior panel and traversal measurements were unpromoted and do not establish a cache cause.
